digest.component_or_area: Plan Review Gate / T5c Security Criterion
propositions: T5c security criterion currently evaluates plan specifications as-written per shared preamble, but 46% of strong findings cite repo artifacts and exploitability is a property of the system not the text, requiring criterion-local grounding override to evaluate current codebase and configuration instead

T5c generates 30% pure template-shape undeclared-access-posture findings that cannot be dropped because they are factually true, causing 99 reviews with duplicate findings and displacing other criteria in 103 advisory-cap-limited reviews, requiring dedup-at-source to emit at most one such finding per plan

Ungrounded candidate findings citing neither read repo artifacts nor quoted plan sentences must be demoted to MINOR severity to prevent them from blocking at the 0.90 threshold while preserving strong grounded findings

T5c blocking must be scoped to two HIGH-severity classes only — plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces — with all other findings capped at MINOR
Routing entry for T5c must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.90 with no pass3_decide or orchestrator changes, using only rubric text and routing config levers per T10 precedent

Rubric rewrite must preserve all phrases pinned by existing tests (trust-boundary gate, loopback carve-out, mixed-scope rule, zero-trust caveat, no-blurring scope) and stay in plan_review_T5c.md with no edits to passes.py or prompts.py per concurrent ticket 9374
